key_points: Q4 EPS guidance missed consensus by ~12%, driving a 7% intraday drop.
Automotive revenue up 61% and non‑handset target raised to $40B, indicating diversification.

Overall sentiment mixed; near‑term volatility expected, but medium‑term outlook improves.
